name: Martha
title: The Busy Hostess
summary: Martha of Bethany was the sister of Mary and Lazarus. She was known for her hospitality and practical service. Jesus gently corrected her when she was too busy with household tasks, but she also showed strong faith when her brother died. Her confession "You are the Messiah" is one of the clearest in the Gospels.

keyEvents.title: The Busy Hostess
keyEvents.description: Martha was busy serving while Jesus visited them, whereas Mary sat and listened.

keyEvents.title: The Confession of Faith
keyEvents.description: When Lazarus died, Martha confessed that Jesus is the Messiah, the Son of God.

keyEvents.title: At the Tomb
keyEvents.description: Martha warned about the smell when Jesus asked to open the tomb, but she trusted him.

keyEvents.title: The Meal in Bethany
keyEvents.description: During the meal six days before Passover, Martha served again, while Mary anointed Jesus' feet.
